Mindcast exists to close the gap between knowing and doing.
A weekly facilitated gathering where ordinary people become more themselves — together, every week, for as long as they want to keep coming.
Notice it. Name it. Do it.
UNCONSCIOUS → CONSCIOUS → CHANGED
Sunday · The Gathering
Every session begins the same way — we return to the intention you set seven days ago. Did you do it? What got in the way? No shame, just honest data.
In the Rooms
Adults, teens and kids move into their own rooms and work the same theme in parallel — live facilitation, workbook prompts, real conversation.
Before You Leave
You write down one specific thing you'll do this week. It goes in your workbook, and it comes back with you next Sunday.

Mindcast began from a simple question about what actually changes people — and the answer was a room, not an app.
The most powerful thing we offer isn't a podcast or a framework. It's the room you walk into each week.
COMMUNITY — a weekly gathering of people who show up for each other.
PRACTICE — a 52-week journey with a weekly rhythm: Sunday session, reflection, intention, Life Group.
TOOLS — a live digital course book, guided reflection and journaling, weekly practices.
Community over content
Draw out, do not preach
Everyone can afford to belong
Safe by design
Honest about what we are
No pressure, ever
Consent before everything
Evidence where possible, honesty about the rest
Inner work is for everyone
Safety is non-negotiable
One step at a time
